name: MonarchLogoCloud
title: LogoCloud
summary: A titled row or grid of organisation logos, such as customers or integrations on a welcome screen, with the name shown as a wordmark while a logo has no image.
whenToUse: On a welcome, onboarding or about screen that names organisations the product may show, with their permission; or a grid of integrations.
whenNotToUse: For organisations a signed-in person belongs to, use a list of rows with avatars. For integrations with descriptions, use MonarchFeatureGrid.
api: @Composable fun MonarchLogoCloud(logos: List<MonarchLogoCloudLogo>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, layout: MonarchLogoCloudLayout = MonarchLogoCloudLayout.Row, size: MonarchLogoCloudSize = MonarchLogoCloudSize.Md, monochrome: Boolean = true, onLogoClick: ((MonarchLogoCloudLogo) -> Unit)? = null, listLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchLogoCloudLogo(name: String, image: Painter? = null, imageDark: Painter? = null, link: String? = null)
enum class MonarchLogoCloudSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: logos
options.description: The organisations in reading order: name, image (a Painter the app loaded), a dark-theme image and an app-defined link.

options.name: title
options.description: The small heading above the logos, drawn in capitals and read as given.

options.name: layout
options.description: A centred wrapping row, or equal bordered cells at least 144dp wide.

options.name: size
options.description: Logo height 24, 32 or 44dp; wordmarks take a matching text style.

options.name: monochrome
options.description: Draws logo images in the muted text colour.

options.name: onLogoClick
options.description: Called with a logo that has a link when it is tapped. Logos without a link, or without this callback, are not interactive.

options.name: listLabel
options.description: The spoken name of the group without a title. null uses "Organisations".

states.name: row
states.description: Logos centred in a row that wraps onto more lines.

states.name: grid
states.description: Equal cells with the default border, as many per row as fit 144dp.

states.name: wordmark
states.description: A logo without an image shows its name in the muted text colour.

states.name: linked
states.description: A logo with a link and onLogoClick is a button with a 48dp touch target and a focus ring.

appearance: Wordmarks and monochrome logos use the muted text colour, the title the muted caption in capitals, and grid cells the default border. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes; imageDark replaces the image in the dark themes.
platformNotes: The web LogoCloud takes image URLs, checks them and falls back to the wordmark when an image fails to load. Monarch for Android adds no image loader: the app passes a Painter, and a missing painter shows the wordmark. The web's hover recolouring has no touch equivalent, so monochrome images stay monochrome. A link is an app-defined string passed back through onLogoClick, not a URL the component opens. The web opens external links in a new tab and says so; on Android the app decides where a link goes.
accessibility: The cloud is a traversal group named by the title, or "Organisations" without one.
The title is read as a heading, in the case it was given, not in capitals.
An image logo is read as the organisation's name; a wordmark is read as its text.
A linked logo is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp; unlinked logos are not focusable.
edgeCases: Long names wrap inside their cell.
An empty list shows only the title.
A logo with a link but no onLogoClick is not interactive.

examples.title: Wordmarks in a row
examples.code:
MonarchLogoCloud(
    logos = listOf("Company A", "Company B", "Company C", "Company D", "Company E", "Company F")
        .map { MonarchLogoCloudLogo(name = it) },
    title = "Placeholder organisations",
)

examples.title: Grid with links
examples.code:
MonarchLogoCloud(
    logos = listOf("Company A", "Company B", "Company C", "Company D").mapIndexed { i, name ->
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo(name = name, link = "integration-${i + 1}")
    },
    title = "Integrations",
    layout = MonarchLogoCloudLayout.Grid,
    size = MonarchLogoCloudSize.Sm,
    onLogoClick = { opened = it.link.orEmpty() },
)
